description: Measurable quality rules for Knowledge Packages. Specification only.

rules.name: required_metadata_completeness
rules.statement: PACKAGE.json required identity fields and manifest metadata must be non-empty and consistent.

rules.name: identifier_quality
rules.statement: package_id, exported ids, and metadata ids must match naming rules, contain no version numbers, and be unique in the working corpus.

rules.name: reference_quality
rules.statement: Non-trivial claims reference resolvable knowledge ids or SRC-* / document paths; TODO_REVIEW is explicit when unknown.

rules.name: dependency_quality
rules.statement: Dependencies are acyclic, version-constrained, justified with reason, and required/optional lists match entries.

rules.name: documentation_completeness
rules.statement: README states purpose and out of scope; CHANGELOG describes the current version from validated onward.

rules.name: package_completeness
rules.statement: Required components for package_type are present (e.g. rules/ for analytical); exported_objects cover public ids.

rules.name: language_consistency
rules.statement: language is in languages[]; object languages are subsets of package languages or mul.

rules.name: example_boundary
rules.statement: Package examples must not be Golden Dataset expected outputs or snapshots.
